description: This source file defines a payload storage service with implementations for storing, retrieving, and managing payloads on the local filesystem, including interfaces, concrete implementations, and utility functions.

classes.name: PayloadRecord
classes.description: Struct that captures metadata about a stored payload blob, including its URI, size, and SHA256 checksum.

classes.name: PayloadStore
classes.description: Interface defining methods for saving, opening, and removing payloads.

classes.name: FilePayloadStore
classes.description: Struct implementing PayloadStore interface, persisting payloads on the local filesystem under a specified base directory.

methods.name: SaveFromReader
methods.description: Streams data from an io.Reader to disk while computing its SHA256 hash, and returns a PayloadRecord with metadata.

methods.name: SaveBytes
methods.description: Saves a byte slice as a payload on disk by wrapping it in a reader.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a payload file for reading given its URI.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a payload file from disk given its URI.

methods.name: resolvePath
methods.description: Resolves a payload URI to an absolute filesystem path within the base directory.

methods.name: randomPayloadID
methods.description: Generates a random 16-byte hex string to be used as payload identifier.

methods.name: copyWithContext
methods.description: Copies data from src to dst respecting context cancellation.
